section.content: 本实用新型公开了锂离子电池，该锂离子电池包括：至少两个极组，所述极组具有主表面和侧壁，所述极组包括正极极片、负极极片以及位于所述正极极片与所述负极极片之间的绝缘隔膜；绝缘垫片，所述绝缘垫片具有主体部和至少位于所述绝缘垫片一端的突起部，所述绝缘垫片位于相邻的所述极组之间，所述绝缘垫片的所述主体部和所述突起部均与所述极组的所述主表面相接触，其中，在所述绝缘垫片的所述突起部远离所述主体部的方向上，所述突起部的厚度逐渐增大。由此，可以减少析锂现象的发生以及提高电池热安全性能。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, this lithium ion battery includes: at least two pole groups having a major surface and a sidewall, the pole groups comprising a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece, and an insulating separator between the positive and negative pole pieces; an insulating spacer having a main body portion and a protrusion portion at least at one end of the insulating spacer, the insulating spacer being located between adjacent pole groups, the main body portion and the protrusion portion of the insulating spacer both being in contact with the main surfaces of the pole groups, wherein the protrusion portion of the insulating spacer gradually increases in thickness in a direction in which the protrusion portion is away from the main body portion. Therefore, the occurrence of lithium precipitation phenomenon can be reduced, and the thermal safety performance of the battery can be improved.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to an energy field specifically, relates to lithium ion battery.

Background

With the clear proposal of 2030 "carbon peak" and 2060 "carbon neutralization" targets in China, the realization of finding a clean energy source capable of replacing fossil energy to meet the double-carbon target is more and more urgent. The lithium ion battery has the advantages of high energy density, long cycle life, recyclability and the like, and is an energy solution with remarkable influence. However, lithium ion batteries also have non-negligible safety hazards in the process of long-term use or circulation, wherein the most typical safety hazards are lithium precipitation abnormalities, that is, a phenomenon that lithium metal is precipitated (precipitated) on a negative electrode, and with the growth of lithium dendrites, the risk of internal short circuit caused by puncturing a diaphragm exists, and meanwhile, because the lithium batteries have the characteristic of high energy density, the internal short circuit easily causes thermal runaway failure of the batteries, and serious safety risks such as fire, explosion and the like are even caused.

Therefore, the current lithium ion battery still needs to be improved.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The present invention is made based on the discovery and recognition by the inventors of the following facts and problems:

the common method for improving lithium separation at the edge of the lithium battery in the related technology comprises the steps of increasing the design N/P ratio of a battery cell, controlling AC-Overhang, controlling the using amount of electrolyte in the lithium battery and the like, so that lithium ions deintercalated from a positive electrode can be timely intercalated. The inventor finds that the occurrence of the lithium separation phenomenon can be only partially reduced after the N/P of the battery core is increased, the occurrence of the lithium separation phenomenon cannot be completely avoided, and the energy density of the battery is also obviously reduced; when the usage amount of the electrolyte is increased, the phenomenon of lithium precipitation cannot be completely avoided, the diffusion path of gas in the battery is reduced, and the manufacturing cost of the whole battery is obviously increased due to high manufacturing cost of the electrolyte.

The present invention aims to alleviate or solve at least one of the above mentioned problems to at least some extent.

In an aspect of the present invention, the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, include: at least two pole groups having a major surface and a sidewall, the pole groups comprising a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece, and an insulating separator between the positive and negative pole pieces; an insulating spacer having a main body portion and a protrusion portion at least at one end of the insulating spacer, the insulating spacer being located between adjacent pole groups, the main body portion and the protrusion portion of the insulating spacer both being in contact with the main surfaces of the pole groups, wherein the protrusion portion of the insulating spacer gradually increases in thickness in a direction in which the protrusion portion is away from the main body portion. Therefore, the occurrence of lithium precipitation phenomenon can be reduced, and the thermal safety performance of the battery can be improved.

Specifically, the electrode group includes a plurality of positive electrode plates, a plurality of negative electrode plates, and a plurality of insulating diaphragms, the insulating diaphragms are arranged between adjacent positive electrode plates, the edge thickness of the positive electrode plates is smaller than the center thickness of the positive electrode plates, and the edge thickness of the negative electrode plates is smaller than the center thickness of the negative electrode plates. This can further improve the performance of the battery.

Specifically, the included angle between the surface of the protrusion part and the surface of the main body part is 0-15 degrees. This can further reduce the occurrence of the lithium deposition phenomenon.

Specifically, the projection has a first projection in contact with the main surface of one of the adjacent pole groups and a second projection in contact with the main surface of the other of the adjacent pole groups. This can further reduce the occurrence of the lithium deposition phenomenon.

Specifically, the difference between the center thickness of the positive pole piece and the edge thickness of the positive pole piece is 0-15 microns, and the difference between the center thickness of the negative pole piece and the edge thickness of the negative pole piece is 0-15 microns. This can further reduce the occurrence of the lithium deposition phenomenon.

Specifically, the number of the positive electrode pieces is m, the number of the negative electrode pieces is n, the difference between the center thickness of the positive electrode piece and the edge thickness of the positive electrode piece is a, the difference between the center thickness of the negative electrode piece and the edge thickness of the negative electrode piece is b, the maximum thickness of the protrusion portion is x, the thickness of the main body portion is y, and x is y + ma + nb. This can further reduce the occurrence of the lithium deposition phenomenon.

Specifically, the width of the protrusion part is 5-40 mm in the direction pointing to the protrusion part along the main body part of the insulation gasket. This can further reduce the occurrence of the lithium deposition phenomenon.

Specifically, the thickness of the main body part in a direction perpendicular to the main surfaces of the pole group is 100 to 2000 μm. This can further reduce the occurrence of the lithium deposition phenomenon.

Specifically, the insulating gasket is one of polypropylene, polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride, teflon, polytetrafluoroethylene, mica and ceramic. Thus, the battery can be applied to various batteries.

Specifically, the lithium ion battery is a laminated lithium ion battery or a wound lithium ion battery. This can further improve the performance of the battery.

Drawings

The above and/or additional aspects and advantages of the present invention will become apparent and readily appreciated from the following description of the embodiments, taken in conjunction with the accompanying drawings of which:

fig. 1 shows a schematic cross-sectional view perpendicular to the major surfaces of a pole set of a battery according to an embodiment of the invention;

fig. 2 is a schematic view showing the structure of an insulating gasket for a battery according to an embodiment of the present invention;

FIG. 3 shows a schematic cross-sectional view of the insulating gasket along AA' of FIG. 2;

fig. 4 shows a schematic diagram of the principle of lithium extraction occurring in a battery according to an embodiment of the present invention;

fig. 5 shows a schematic diagram of the principle of lithium deposition in a battery according to yet another embodiment of the present invention.

Description of reference numerals:

10: a pole group; 11: a negative pole piece; 12: a positive electrode plate; 20: an insulating spacer; 21: a main body portion; 22: a protrusion portion.

Detailed Description

Reference will now be made in detail to embodiments of the present invention, examples of which are illustrated in the accompanying drawings, wherein like reference numerals refer to the same or similar elements or elements having the same or similar function throughout. The embodiments described below with reference to the drawings are exemplary only for the purpose of explaining the present invention, and should not be construed as limiting the present invention.

In an aspect of the present invention, the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, referring to fig. 1 and 4, including: at least two pole groups 10, the pole groups 10 having a main surface and a side wall, the pole groups 10 including a positive pole piece 11, a negative pole piece 12, and an insulating diaphragm (not shown in the figure) between the positive pole piece 11 and the negative pole piece 12; and an insulating gasket 20, wherein the insulating gasket 20 is provided with a main body part 21 and a protruding part 22 at least positioned at one end of the insulating gasket 20, the insulating gasket 20 is positioned between adjacent pole groups 10, the main body part 21 and the protruding part 22 of the insulating gasket 20 are both contacted with the main surface of the pole group 10, and the thickness of the protruding part 22 is gradually increased in the direction that the protruding part 22 of the insulating gasket 20 is far away from the main body part 21. Through implant insulating gasket in the inside utmost point of lithium ion battery between the group and cut the effect of district's application to battery inside utmost point group edge, increase the pole piece laminating that the district was cut at utmost point group edge, reduce lithium cell charge-discharge in-process lithium ion's transmission distance to the inside edge lithium problem of analyzing that does not closely lead to because of cutting the district laminating of lithium cell is effectively reduced.

For ease of understanding, the following description is made of the principle of the battery in the present application having the above-described advantageous effects:

the inventors have discovered that the occurrence of lithium separation during battery cycling is generally associated with problems associated with the design of the N/P ratio of the battery, electrode material failure, and poor pole piece attachment. After a great deal of theoretical analysis and experimental research, the inventors further found that, referring to fig. 4 and 5, taking a copper foil as a pole piece substrate, and coating slurry on the substrate to form a positive pole piece 12 and a negative pole piece 11 as an example, because the slurry in the coating process of the lithium battery pole piece has a certain thinning region (see the shaded part in the circle in fig. 4) at the edge of the pole piece due to the flow characteristics of the slurry itself, the pole piece thickness of the thinning region has a certain thickness difference with the pole piece thickness of the main region (see the region outside the circle in fig. 4), the N/P ratio of the battery is difficult to control in the thinning region, the negative pole surface density of the thinning region is low, and the N/P ratio is easily over the lower limit, that is, the negative pole insertion point of the region is less than the positive pole delithiation amount, lithium ions diffuse to the edge thinning region of the negative pole piece, so that lithium precipitation occurs at the edge of the pole piece (see the region inside the circle in fig. 5), in addition, as the operations of tab pre-welding, cutting, final welding, tab bending and the like can be carried out subsequently on the laminated battery cell, the edge area of the tab can be pulled to some extent, gaps between thinning areas of the positive electrode piece 12 and the negative electrode piece 11 are increased, the transmission distance of lithium ions is further increased, and the lithium ions which are extracted from the positive electrode cannot be embedded in the negative electrode in time, so that the lithium ions are accumulated on the surface of the negative electrode to cause lithium precipitation.

In the present application, the inventors found that, referring to fig. 1, fig. 2 and fig. 3, by adding an insulating spacer 20 with gradually changing thickness (the protruding portion 22 is thicker, and the main portion 21 is thinner) between the electrode groups 10, the adhesion degree of the electrode thinning region during the hot pressing and assembling process of the electrode groups 10 can be effectively improved, and the thickness difference between the electrode thinning region and the middle position of the electrode plate is eliminated, so as to reduce the migration distance of lithium ions from the positive electrode to the negative electrode, and avoid the lithium separation phenomenon caused by the accumulation of lithium ions at the negative electrode. Meanwhile, due to the existence of the insulating gaskets 20 between the electrode groups 10 in the battery, certain blocking effect exists on the heat transfer in the thermal runaway battery, the phenomenon of thermal spreading of the battery can be effectively improved, and the thermal safety performance of the battery pack is improved.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, the structure of the pole group is not particularly limited, for example, the pole group may include a plurality of positive pole pieces, a plurality of negative pole pieces, and a plurality of insulating diaphragms, with an insulating diaphragm between adjacent pole pieces, wherein the edge thickness of the positive pole piece is smaller than the center thickness of the positive pole piece, and the edge thickness of the negative pole piece is smaller than the center thickness of the negative pole piece. According to other embodiments of the present invention, the connection mode of the insulating spacer and the pole group is not particularly limited, for example, the insulating spacer and the adjacent pole group can be attached after the pole piece lamination inside the pole group is completed or before the pole group stacking process, and the attaching mode can include at least one of hot pressing, bonding and layer stacking.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, referring to fig. 3, the structure of the insulating gasket is not particularly limited, for example, the included angle between the surface of the protrusion portion 22 and the surface of the main body portion 21 may be 0 to 15 °. The thickness of the protruding part of the insulating gasket is thick, the thickness of the main body part is thin, the thickness of one end, in contact with the main body part, of the protruding part is consistent with that of the main body part, and the thickness of the protruding part is gradually and uniformly increased in the direction from the protruding part to the main body part.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, the structure of the insulating gasket is not particularly limited, for example, referring to fig. 3, the protrusion may have a first protrusion contacting with a main surface of one of the adjacent pole groups and a second protrusion contacting with a main surface of the other of the adjacent pole groups. It can be understood that when the protruding portion of the insulating gasket has a protrusion facing the pole group, the lithium deposition phenomenon inside the pole group in contact with the protrusion can be effectively alleviated. When the protruding portion of the insulating gasket has two first protruding portions and two second protruding portions facing the adjacent pole groups, respectively, the lithium deposition phenomenon inside the pole group in contact with the corresponding protruding portions can be effectively alleviated.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, since the slurry of the coating process of the lithium battery electrode plate has a flowing characteristic, a certain thinning region exists at the edge of the electrode plate, and thus there is a certain difference between the edge thickness of the electrode plate and the center thickness of the electrode plate, for example, referring to fig. 4, the difference between the center thickness of the positive electrode plate 12 and the edge thickness of the positive electrode plate 12 may be 0 to 15 micrometers, and further, may be 0 to 7 micrometers; the difference between the center thickness of the negative electrode plate 11 and the edge thickness of the negative electrode plate 11 can be 0-15 micrometers, and further can be 0-9 micrometers. It is understood that the difference between the edge thickness and the central thickness of the pole piece refers to the sum of the difference between the thinned regions on both sides of the pole piece and the central thickness.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, the maximum thickness value of the protruding portion of the insulating spacer is not particularly limited, for example, referring to fig. 3, when the number of the positive electrode pieces is m, the number of the negative electrode pieces is n, the difference between the center thickness of the positive electrode piece and the edge thickness of the positive electrode piece is a, and the difference between the center thickness of the negative electrode piece and the edge thickness of the negative electrode piece is b, in the direction perpendicular to the main surface of the electrode group, the maximum thickness value of the protruding portion 22 is x, the thickness of the main body portion 21 is y, at this time, the maximum thickness value of the protruding portion may be x ═ y + ma + nb, thereby effectively making the positive electrode piece and the negative electrode piece in the electrode group effectively fit, and reducing the occurrence of the lithium deposition phenomenon.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, the structure of the insulating spacer is not particularly limited, for example, referring to fig. 2, in a direction along the main body portion of the insulating spacer toward the protruding portion, the width of the protruding portion may be 5 to 40 mm, and further, may be 5 to 30 mm.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, the structure of the insulating spacer is not particularly limited, for example, referring to fig. 3, the thickness of the main body portion 21 may be 100 to 2000 micrometers in a direction perpendicular to the main surface of the pole group.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, a material forming the insulating spacer is not particularly limited, for example, the insulating spacer may be formed of a non-metal material, and in particular, the insulating spacer may be formed of one of polypropylene, polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride, teflon, polytetrafluoroethylene, mica, and ceramic.

According to some embodiments of the present invention, the structure of the lithium ion battery is not particularly limited, for example, the lithium ion battery may be a laminate type lithium ion battery or a winding type lithium ion battery. After the battery pole group is laminated or wound, the insulating gasket is adhered to the surface of the battery pole group in the modes of hot pressing, bonding, layered stacking and the like before the pole group stacking process, the thinning area of the battery pole piece is continuously pressed in the subsequent battery assembling and using processes to ensure the adhesion degree of the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece, the distance between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece in the thinning area is ensured to be consistent with the main area, and the occurrence of the phenomenon of lithium precipitation at the edge caused by overlarge pole piece distance in the thinning area is reduced.

The following embodiments are provided to illustrate the present application, and should not be construed as limiting the scope of the present application. The examples do not specify particular techniques or conditions, and are performed according to techniques or conditions described in literature in the art or according to the product specification. The reagents or instruments used are conventional products which are commercially available, and are not indicated by manufacturers.

Example 1:

the battery comprises at least two pole groups, a single pole group of the battery comprises 38 positive pole pieces and negative pole pieces which are sequentially and alternately stacked, the difference value between the center thickness of the positive pole piece and the edge thickness of the positive pole piece is 9 micrometers, the difference value between the center thickness of the negative pole piece and the edge thickness of the negative pole piece is 6 micrometers, the thickness of a main body part of an insulating gasket is 300 micrometers, a protruding part of the insulating gasket comprises a first protruding part and a second protruding part, the maximum thickness of the protruding part is 870 micrometers, the lithium ion battery is subjected to 1C/1C charging and discharging circulation for 500 weeks at the normal temperature of 25 ℃, the battery is disassembled under the circulation condition, and the condition of the negative pole piece of the battery is observed.

Example 2:

example 2 is the same as example 1, except that the battery single pole group comprises 64 positive pole pieces and negative pole pieces which are sequentially and alternately stacked, the difference between the center thickness of the positive pole piece and the edge thickness of the positive pole piece is 6 micrometers, the difference between the center thickness of the negative pole piece and the edge thickness of the negative pole piece is 3 micrometers, the thickness of the main part of the insulating gasket is 400 micrometers, the maximum value of the thickness of the protruding part of the insulating gasket is 976 micrometers, the lithium ion battery is subjected to 1C/1C charge-discharge cycle at the high temperature of 45 ℃ for 300 weeks, the battery is disassembled under the cycle condition, and the condition of the negative pole piece of the battery is observed.

Example 3:

example 3 is the same as example 1, except that the single battery pole group comprises 42 positive pole pieces and 42 negative pole pieces which are sequentially and alternately stacked, the difference between the center thickness of the positive pole piece and the edge thickness of the positive pole piece is 7 micrometers, the difference between the center thickness of the negative pole piece and the edge thickness of the negative pole piece is 5 micrometers, the thickness of the main part of the insulating gasket is 400 micrometers, and the maximum value of the thickness of the protruding part of the insulating gasket is 904 micrometers. The lithium ion battery is subjected to 1.3C/1.3C charge-discharge cycle for 500 weeks at the normal temperature of 25 ℃, the battery is disassembled under the cycle condition, and the condition of a negative pole piece of the battery is observed.

Example 4:

example 4 is the same as example 1, except that the single electrode group of the battery comprises 58 positive electrode plates and negative electrode plates which are sequentially and alternately stacked, the difference between the center thickness of the positive electrode plate and the edge thickness of the positive electrode plate is 6 micrometers, the difference between the center thickness of the negative electrode plate and the edge thickness of the negative electrode plate is 6 micrometers, the thickness of the main body part of the insulating gasket is 300 micrometers, the maximum value of the thickness of the protruding part of the insulating gasket is 996 micrometers, the lithium ion battery is subjected to 1.3C/1.3C charge-discharge cycle at the normal temperature of 25 ℃ for 500 weeks, the battery is disassembled under the cycle condition, and the condition of the negative electrode plate of the battery is observed.

Test results show that after the batteries in the embodiments 1 to 4 are dissected, no grey-white lithium powder is observed on the negative electrode plate, which indicates that the thinning regions of the positive and negative electrode plates are effectively attached by adding an insulating gasket structure between the electrode groups of the lithium batteries to extrude the thinning regions of the negative electrode plates, and no lithium precipitation occurs in the thinning regions at the edges of the negative electrode plates in the battery charging and discharging and circulating processes.
